semiconductor_relevance: High — 3SLINE Co., Ltd. specializes in high-purity PFA vessels and piping used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: 3SLINE Co., Ltd. is a leader in the manufacturing of large-sized PFA vessels and piping systems that are essential for chemical storage and transport in semiconductor and LCD processes. Their products are designed to offer excellent chemical and corrosion resistance, making them suitable for critical applications in the semiconductor industry.
